root_cause: Only the OoO-overlap observation fails while the program still retires correctly (no trace mismatches, no timeout, no other failing checks), so the design is functionally right but never exhibits/propagates the required 'younger independent ALU issues and completes while an older load waits on external memory' event. The two candidate mechanisms, in order, are: (1) the issue/wakeup path in issue_queue never schedules the younger ALU in parallel with the outstanding load (in-order single-issue selection, or issue/disp gated on LSU busy / on load_complete), and (2) the completion side-band that forms dbg_ooo_bypass (alu_complete_valid/alu_complete_rob_index into ROB/IQ, and the outstanding-load flag used to qualify the pulse) is not actually driven/connected, so even a real overlap produces no event. Previous patching of load_store_unit and the top level did not change the symptom, so the defect is most likely in the issue/completion control outside those two files, not in the memory data path.
repair_constraints: Do not rename any port, module, or file; keep every interface exactly as in the plan contract (rv32i5 top-level, issue_queue, execute_alu, reorder_buffer, load_store_unit, physical_register_file).

dbg_ooo_issue must remain the cycle an IQ-resident valid instruction is truly accepted by a functional unit; dbg_ooo_bypass must mark a real event where, with an older unfinished load outstanding, a younger independent integer ALU instruction is issued and completes (per real internal state, at most one event per cycle, no counters or PC-pattern fakes).
Do not weaken correctness to create the event: the ALU must not be allowed to bypass a true register/data dependency on the in-flight load, and memory ordering/store semantics must be preserved.

All currently passing checks must stay passing: retire pulse/PC/insn per committed instruction, branch-predictor resolve/mispredict events, cache miss/refill and epoch handling, halt/exit_code timing (halted and exit_code appear on the same cycle after the ECALL commit, outputs frozen afterwards).
Any touch of rename_unit.sv (outstanding constant-index rewrite of the checkpoint-save row write) must be behavior-preserving and must keep the teacher TB passing.
